bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 6" x 9" are allowed. All bags are searched at entry.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Small clutches up to 6" x 9" (do not need to be clear)
prohibited: Non-clear bags larger than a clutch
Strollers, wagons and other wheeled devices (mobility devices excepted)
bagPolicy.note: Bags or small coolers needed for medical supplies are allowed after a brief inspection and tagged as medical bags. No re-entry.

parking.summary: Official venue guidance provides event parking information; recommends or requires advance purchase where offered.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use the Virginia War Memorial bus loop at 2nd Street and Brown’s Island Way for pickup and drop-off. Drivers must enter and exit southbound on 2nd Street. Wait for a police officer to help you cross. The zone is monitored from one hour before doors until 30 minutes after the show.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Official venue guidance says food and beverage concessions are available.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Official venue guidance describes an accessible or stair-free entrance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not permitted. If you leave, you need a new ticket to get back in, so bring everything you need.

ticketPickup.summary: Official venue guidance provides mobile or digital ticket instructions on the linked page.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Enter at the main entrance on 5th St. between Bragg St. and Tredegar St., where the box office opens 1 hour before door time on event days. The Brown's Island Way entrance is closest to the rideshare point.
